fit_reason: Private seller listing a complete 2015 Mazda3 hatchback, a car we can detail.
findings: Exterior paint looks clean and glossy in all four outside shots, with good reflections on the doors and hood
Light grime and darkening on the cream leather driver seat bolster and seat cushion
Some wear and light soiling visible on the steering wheel leather
Headlight lenses look fairly clear with only slight haze at the edges
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Mazda3 hatchback and the paint already looks sharp. The cream leather on the driver seat is showing some light grime on the bolster and cushion, which tends to stand out to buyers on a light interior. We do mobile pre-sale details and can clean and condition the leather at your place. Would you like a quote?
